items.title: Wolfe Research cuts T-Mobile as revenue growth forecast risk tilts negative
items.summary: Investing.com -- Wolfe Research downgraded T-Mobile US to Peer Perform from Outperform on Friday, saying the carrier faces mounting competitive pressure in its core market alongside a capital spending cycle that could weigh on shareholder returns.

items.title: AST SpaceMobile Gets FCC Nod To Test 800 MHz Satellite Connectivity – A Look At The Key Highlights
items.summary: The Federal Communications Commission granted temporary approval to AST SpaceMobile to test satellite connectivity using up to 100 commercially available devices.

items.title: VZ Paid Holders $59 Billion While The Stock Trailed The Market
items.summary: The telecom giant sent a torrent of cash to its owners, yet the stock went nowhere. Here is the accounting of what that trade-off bought, and what it means now.

items.title: Churches Fume at $40,000 Bills to Scrap Antennas After Dish’s Bankruptcy
items.summary: More than 3,000 small property owners around the US agreed to install Dish antennas on their rooftops to generate extra income. They're now being told to shoulder the cost to take them down.

items.title: What the Coming 6G Trials With Nvidia, T-Mobile Could Mean for Nokia Investors
items.summary: Nokia stock has surged nearly 150% over the past year on the promise of AI-powered 6G, and now Nvidia and T-Mobile are putting that promise to a real-world test. What the trial results could mean for shareholders depends on a question Nokia has not yet answered.
